message.content:
### Overall Layout & Structure  
The page uses a **dark (near-black) background** with a clean, minimalist layout divided into three main sections: a top card, a central content block, and a footer. The design is monochromatic with strategic use of gold/yellow accents for emphasis.  


### Top Section: Service Card  
- **Container**: A rounded rectangular card with a slightly lighter dark gray background (for subtle contrast against the black backdrop).  
- **Icon**: A small, white diamond ring icon (likely a wedding ring) at the top-left of the card, adding a visual cue for the "wedding dinner" service.  
- **Typography**:  
  - **Title**: "Свадебный ужин" (Wedding Dinner) in a **serif font** (e.g., Times New Roman or similar), white, and bold—clearly defining the service.  
  - **Body Text**: Smaller, lighter gray text describing the service: *"Авторское меню для самого важного дня. Персональный шеф, дегустация и координация вечера."* (Author’s menu for the most important day. Personal chef, tasting, and evening coordination).  
- **Call-to-Action (CTA)**: A gold/yellow link, *"ПОДРОБНЕЕ →"* (MORE →), in a smaller, sans-serif font (e.g., Arial) with a right arrow, encouraging users to learn more.  
- **Spacing**: Generous padding inside the card (top/bottom ~20px, left/right ~30px) and margin below the card (~50px) to separate it from the next section.  


### Central Section: Menu Consultation Block  
- **Headline**: "Обсудите меню с шеф-поваром" (Discuss the menu with the chef) in a **mix of serif (white) and script/gold font** for "с шеф-поваром" (with the chef)—adding elegance and hierarchy.  
- **Body Text**: Three lines of light gray, sans-serif text explaining the consultation process: *"Каждое блюдо — это результат диалога. Шеф-повар выслушает ваши пожелания, предложит оптимальные сочетания и проведёт персональную дегустацию. Мы уверены: вкус должен превзойти ожидания ещё до мероприятия."* (Each dish is a result of dialogue. The chef will listen to your wishes, suggest optimal combinations, and conduct a personal tasting. We are sure: the taste should exceed expectations even before the event).  
- **Buttons**: Two prominent CTAs:  
  - Left: Gold/yellow button, *"ОБСУДИТЬ МЕНЮ С ШЕФ-ПОВАРом"* (Discuss the menu with the chef), in a bold, sans-serif font.  
  - Right: Black button with white text, *"ПОЗВОНИТЬ"* (Call), in a smaller, sans-serif font.  
- **Spacing**: The headline is centered, with body text aligned center below it. Buttons are spaced evenly (horizontal gap ~20px) and centered, with vertical padding (~30px top/bottom) to avoid clutter.  


### Footer  
- **Content**: Left-aligned text: *"ИП Нинов Д.И. ИНН 781643753900 : Nilov Catering : © 2014-2026"* (legal/business info) in light gray, sans-serif font. Right-aligned links: *"О компании"* (About), *"Политика конфиденциальности"* (Privacy Policy), *"Контакты"* (Contacts) in the same light gray, sans-serif font.  
- **Icon**: A small, black circular logo with a white "N" at the far left (brand identifier).  
- **Spacing**: Thin (~10px) top margin from the central section, with padding inside the footer (~15px top/bottom) for readability.  


### Colors  
- **Primary Background**: Black (#000000 or near-black).  
- **Accent Colors**: Gold/yellow (#D4AF37 or similar) for CTAs and script text; white for titles/icons; light gray (#888888 or similar) for body text/links.  


### Typography  
- **Serif Fonts**: Used for titles (e.g., "Свадебный ужин", "Обсудите меню") to convey elegance.  
- **Sans-Serif Fonts**: Used for body text, links, and buttons (e.g., "ПОДРОБНЕЕ", "ОБСУДИТЬ МЕНЮ") for readability and modernity.  
- **Hierarchy**: Clear distinction between titles (larger, bolder) and body text (smaller, lighter).  


### Spacing  
- **Padding/Margins**: Generous whitespace around cards, text blocks, and buttons to avoid a cramped feel. Consistent spacing between sections (e.g., ~50px between the top card and central block) enhances flow.  


### Images  
- Only one small icon (diamond ring) is present—minimalist, with no large images, keeping focus on text.  


### Visual Issues (if any)  
- **Contrast**: The gold CTA buttons stand out well against the black background, but the black "ПОЗВОНИТЬ" button may blend slightly with the background (though white text provides sufficient contrast).  
- **Consistency**: The mix of serif and sans-serif fonts is intentional (for hierarchy) but could be refined for stricter consistency (e.g., using the same sans-serif for all body text).  
- **Responsiveness**: The layout appears optimized for desktop (centered content, fixed-width buttons), but mobile adaptability (e.g., button stacking) is not visible in the screenshot.  


Overall, the design is sleek, professional, and focused on guiding users toward key actions (learning more, discussing the menu, or calling). The dark theme and gold accents create a luxurious, wedding-focused aesthetic.
